messages:

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-hosted Open House — promo codes for attendee trials

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host our Open House on Nov 17. We typically offer attendees a quick hands-on trial to drive follow-ups — this time we'd like to provide Redwood trial credits so folks can run a short integration and see latency/cost differences in their projects.

Event details:
- Expected registrants: ~250 (onsite + virtual)
- Date: Nov 17, 2026
- Preferred trial window: 14 days (open to 30 days if you recommend)

What we're asking: 250 single-use promo codes that grant trial credits (we were thinking ~10k tokens each but open to your suggestion). We'll distribute codes via our attendee portal and email. We also plan a short follow-up survey and a co-marketing highlight.

Attached is our sponsor brief with expected audience and deliverables. Can you confirm feasibility, typical expiration window, and lead time to get codes? Also: any legal/branding notes we should include when we announce the trial?

Appreciate it — Sophie

--
Sophie Lin
Head of Partnerships | BrightDevs Events
openhouse logistics attached: openhouse_sponsor_brief.pdf (attachment)

Forwarding Sophie from BrightDevs — they want trial credits for ~250 attendees on Nov 17. Quick thoughts:
- Quantity: 250 codes (single-use)
- Denomination: Sophie suggested 10k tokens; we could do tiered (standard + VIP) if marketing thinks bigger will drive demos
- Length: they asked for 14 days; our standard promo engine can support 14 or 30 days. Longer window increases support/usage cost.
- Expiration: ops, what do we usually set? 30/60/90 days post-issue?

Marissa — do you approve allocation from the promo pool? Laura — can your team generate and deliver by Nov 10? I noted BrightDevs will distribute the codes themselves.

Connor

Connor / Laura — happy to support this. A couple of suggestions to balance adoption and cost:
- Recommend a tiered distribution: 200 standard codes at 5k tokens each, 50 VIP codes at 20k tokens each (we can mark VIP for post-event nurture).
- Set trial window to 30 days for the VIP batch and 14 days for standard. Longer VIP windows help RAs convert.
- Campaign tag: openhouse_brightdevs_2026 so we can track usage in console and tie to later invoices/credits.

If operations can create single-use codes and provide a CSV, we'll approve allocation from the events promo pool. Laura, what are the cost implications? If we need to limit token counts we can drop standard to 4k tokens.

Marissa

Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-hosted Open House — promo codes for attendee trials

Thanks — we can support the tiered plan. Operational details and constraints below: 

1) Code generation
- We will create single-use alphanumeric promo codes (CSV output).
- Max single batch: 500 codes (fits their requested 250).
- Delivery: we can send the CSV to events@brightdevs.com or upload to a secure S3 link.

2) Denomination / windows
- Standard: 200 codes x 5,000 tokens, 14-day activation window from first redemption.
- VIP: 50 codes x 20,000 tokens, 30-day activation window from first redemption.
- All codes to expire (unredeemed) on 2026-12-31 to keep accounting clean.

3) Tracking / tags
- We'll tag all redemptions with campaign=openhouse_brightdevs_2026. Please confirm this exact tag so analytics pipelines map correctly.

4) Timeline & deliverables
- Need final attendee count + preferred deliver-to method by EOD Nov 9.
- We'll generate a sample test code (one standard, one VIP) and send back within 48 hours of confirmation.
- Full batch delivered by Nov 10 if we get the final list by Nov 9.

5) Legal/branding/notes
- Please include the short Redwood privacy blurb when distributing codes (we'll provide). No separate DocuSign needed for credits, but co-marketing materials referencing Redwood should be sent to partnerships@redwood.com for sign-off.

I've attached a promo_code_matrix.csv with the denomination layout and header format we will use for delivery.

Laura

Attachment: promo_code_matrix.csv (columns: code,type,tokens,expires,notes)
